lines.en: label nodokaspecial30p3:
scene nodokashotengai1
: Okay, so, now that that’s over and done with and you’ve made everybody uncomfortable, what now? You promised us food and I have yet to see so much as a snack.
lines.zh: : 好了，既然那事总算结束、你也把大家都弄得不舒服了，那么现在呢？你答应过请我们吃饭的，可我连一块零食都还没见到。

lines.en: : Empty the purse, Nodoka. I know you’re holding out on us.
lines.zh: : 把钱包掏出来，Nodoka。我知道你在藏着掖着。

lines.en: : Apologies. That ran longer than I expected. Guess my newest book is a bit of a hit, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。比我预想的拖久了些。看来我的新书还算小有人气，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, I wonder where you got the story from?
lines.zh: : 是啊，我倒想知道你这故事是从哪儿来的？

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai2
: What can I say? I can find inspiration in anything. I shan’t be blamed for simply drawing upon my own experiences.
lines.zh: : 我能说什么呢？我什么都能找到灵感。我只是取材于自己的经历，总不能怪我吧。

lines.en: : If you’d take the time to read it yourself, I’m sure you’d come to like it. It’s not as if I know {i}everything.{/i} There’s plenty in there I was forced to make up.
lines.zh: : 如果您肯花时间自己读一读，我相信您会喜欢上的。我又不是{i}什么都{/i}知道。里面有很多地方是我被迫编出来的。

lines.en: : Hi. Rin here. Still hungry. Please feed.
lines.zh: : 嗨。Rin 在此。还饿着。请投喂。

lines.en: : It’s late, but I don’t think anything around here closes down until a few hours from now. Did you get, like...some sort of allowance from your publishing company or whatever? How does this work?
lines.zh: : 已经很晚了，不过这一带应该还要过几个小时才关门吧。你有没有从出版社什么的拿到……那种津贴之类的？这到底是怎么运作的？

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai3
: It works via the combination of digital deposit and the magic, rectangular card in my pocket that I use to pay for everything.
lines.zh: : 运作方式就是电子入账，加上我口袋里那张神奇的矩形卡片——我用它付一切账。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. So it’s not free. You’re just paying for it.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。所以不是免费的。就是你付钱而已。

lines.en: : It’s free for you, which we all know is the only thing that matters.
lines.zh: : 对你们来说是免费的，而我们都知道，这才是唯一重要的。

lines.en: : I’d normally offer to pay, but I’ll accept an expensive dinner as compensation for using my likeness in your novel.
lines.zh: : 换作平时我会说我来付，不过我愿意接受一顿昂贵的晚餐，作为你擅自把我的形象写进小说里的补偿。

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai4
: What do you mean you’d {i}offer to pay?{/i} Aren’t you cheap as hell? When have you ever offered to buy me anything?
lines.zh: : 什么叫换作平时你{i}会付{/i}？你不是抠门得要死吗？你什么时候说过要给我买什么东西？

lines.en: : I’ll start offering you things once you start being nicer to me and stop tackling me in dark rooms.
lines.zh: : 等你对我好点、别再在黑屋子里扑倒我，我就开始给你买东西。

lines.en: : Totally ignoring that I just heard any of that and getting back to the food thing- where are we going? There was this street we passed on the way here that I think should have a bunch of food trucks.
lines.zh: : 我刚才什么都没听见啊，完全没听见，咱们回到吃的上来——我们到底要去哪儿？来的时候路过了一条街，我觉得那儿应该有一堆餐车。

lines.en: : It didn’t have any on the way over, but I’ve got a feeling they’re there now. And you can trust me. I have special food truck senses.
lines.zh: : 来的时候一辆都没有，但我有种感觉，它们现在就在那儿。你们可以相信我。我有特殊的餐车感应。

lines.en: : I was thinking we could celebrate my success by doing something a bit more upscale. Perhaps a nice sushi bar or some other comparable restaurant?
lines.zh: : 我在想，我们可以去个稍微高档点的地方，庆祝一下我的成功。比如一家不错的寿司店，或者类似的餐厅？

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai5
: Uhh, actually, Otoha and I kind of have a 0%% success rate when it comes to restaurant dates, so if we could choose somewhere that’s like, not inside...that would be cool.
lines.zh: : 呃，其实，我和 Otoha 在“餐厅约会”这件事上的成功率是 0%，所以如果能选个不在室内的地方……那就太好了。

lines.en: : The sample size is only one, but...yeah. What Rin said.
lines.zh: : 样本量只有一个，不过……嗯。Rin 说得对。

lines.en: : I remember that day. I made out with Otoha’s teacher in the bathroom.
lines.zh: : 我记得那天。我和 Otoha 的老师在洗手间里接吻了。

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai6
: You made out with yourself in the bathroom? How is that even possible?
lines.zh: : 你在洗手间里跟自己接吻？这怎么可能啊？

lines.en: : Do tell. And don’t mind if you see me reach into my pocket to press a button while you’re speaking. I can promise you I’m not recording any of this. You have my word.
lines.zh: : 请继续说。要是您看到我把手伸进口袋里按了个按钮，也请别介意。我可以保证，我没有在录任何东西。我以我的名誉担保。

lines.en: : Your word means nothing to me, Nodoka. And I should probably stop talking about this since I’m finally on decent terms with your roommate again.
lines.zh: : 你的名誉对我来说一文不值，Nodoka。而且我大概也该停止聊这个了，毕竟我好不容易才跟你室友重新处好关系。

lines.en: : Decent might be a bit of an overstatement, but thank you.
lines.zh: : “处好”可能有点言过其实了，不过谢谢。

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai7

: Is there anything that...fits our {i}criteria{/i} around here? Because I’m not trying to be pushy but, if you can’t think of anything, I’m just going to start walking towards Schroedinger’s food truck alley.
lines.zh: : 这附近有没有符合我们{i}条件{/i}的地方？因为我不想催你们，不过要是你想不出来，我就要自己往薛定谔的餐车小巷走了。

lines.en: : Hmm...I believe there’s a shotengai not far from here with a varied assortment of foods. I remember passing by during my last signing.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我记得离这儿不远有一条商店街，吃的种类挺杂。上次签售的时候路过过。

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai8

: Time for another weebnote! A “shotengai” is a shopping street in Japan that is closed to car traffic! They’re typically stocked with local goods sold by local vendors at cheaper-than-average prices!
lines.zh: : 又到了 weebnote 时间！“商店街”是日本的一种购物街，禁止车辆通行！通常由本地摊贩售卖本地商品，价格低于平均水平！

lines.en: : If there’s something you’re looking for, whether it be croquettes, sandals, okonomiyaki, or other household items, the local shotengai is always a safe bet!
lines.zh: : 无论你在找什么——可乐饼、凉鞋、御好烧，还是其他日用品，本地的商店街永远是稳妥的选择！

lines.en: : Plus, shopping at them is great for stimulating the local economy! And many of them partner up with other vendors in the area for exclusive deals! I highly recommend them!
lines.zh: : 而且，在商店街购物对刺激本地经济很有帮助！其中很多还会和附近其他摊贩合作，推出独家优惠！我强烈推荐！

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai9
: Why did Molly just show up and lecture Sensei about shotengai?
lines.zh: : 为什么 Molly 会突然冒出来，给 Sensei 讲一通商店街？

lines.en: : She does that sometimes. She’s probably just one of Nodoka’s fans and was already in the area.
lines.zh: : 她有时候就这样。她大概只是 Nodoka 的粉丝之一，本来就在这附近。

lines.en: : What a shame. I never even got to sign a copy of my book for her. I wonder if she was too embarrassed?
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。我连一本签名本都没能送她。不知道她是不是太害羞了？

lines.en: : Molly? Embarrassed? Sure. And I prefer men.
lines.zh: : Molly？害羞？是啊。而且我更喜欢男人。

lines.en: : Let’s do this shotengai thing before everything closes down. I’d like to get as far away from here as possible as {i}soon{/i} as possible before more people think I’m in costume.
lines.zh: : 趁店还没关门，赶紧去商店街吧。我想{i}尽快{/i}、尽量远离这儿，免得更多人以为我在角色扮演。

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai10
: I’m surprised they recognized you at all. That shirt looks significantly thinner than the one my book describes.
lines.zh: : 我真惊讶他们居然能认出您。您这件衬衫看起来可比我书里描写的那件薄多了。

lines.en: : Not hard to recognize a huge dude with a huge dick!
lines.zh: : 一个又高又壮、鸡巴又大的家伙，想认不出来都难！

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai11
: Bro.
lines.zh: : 哥们儿。

lines.en: : Otoha, I have absolutely no idea why I said that. I’ve never even seen it before. Unless you count the one time at the gym, but that was through the pants for like five seconds and it doesn’t count.
lines.zh: : Otoha，我完全不知道我为什么会说那句话。我根本没见过它。除非你在健身房那次也算，可那是隔着裤子，就五秒钟，不算数。

lines.en: : Also my mom grabbed it and Futaba told me and you need to kiss me or I’m just going to keep ranting about this.
lines.zh: : 而且我妈还抓过它，是 Futaba 告诉我的，所以你得亲我一下，不然我就要继续没完没了地说这个。

lines.en: : Yeah...how about we eat first and make out later? I’d prefer if you’re not thinking about dicks while we’re kissing.
lines.zh: : 行吧……我们要不先吃饭，之后再亲热？我更希望我们接吻的时候，你脑子里别想着鸡巴。

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai12
: I understand and apologize. I will try harder to keep all phallic commentary to myself. My lips are sealed. Until you unseal them, I mean. At that point, they will come unsealed.
lines.zh: : 我理解，并且道歉。我会更加努力，把所有关于那话儿的评论都憋在自己心里。我的嘴封上了。我的意思是，等您把它封上的时候——到那时，它们就会被解封。

lines.en: : Will you do me the honors of carrying my display-purse, Sensei? My hand is beginning to cramp.
lines.zh: : 您能赏脸帮我拿一下这只装饰用的手提包吗，Sensei？我的手开始抽筋了。

lines.en: : I will not and that sucks for you.
lines.zh: : 不行，你自求多福吧。

lines.en: : Not even if I let you be my boyfriend for the rest of the night? It seems only fair that we couple ourselves together if our companions are going to be doing the same.
lines.zh: : 就算我让您当我的男朋友，当到今晚结束也不行？既然我们的同伴也要成双成对，我们把自己凑成一对才公平吧。

lines.en: : Does it come with all of the standard benefits being a boyfriend entails?
lines.zh: : 那包含当男朋友应有的一切标准福利吗？

lines.en: : You mean like taking my pants off and gently nibbling on my-
lines.zh: : 您是说，像脱掉我的裤子，然后轻轻啃我的——

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai13
: Okay, come on. That’s enough of them for now.
lines.zh: : 好了，行了。他们俩的戏份到此为止吧。

lines.en: : What?! But we were just about to get to the good part!
lines.zh: : 什么？！可我们刚要到精彩的部分啊！

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai14
: Otohaaaaa!
lines.zh: : Otohaaaaaa！

lines.en: : Please continue. You didn’t get to finish your sentence.
lines.zh: : 请继续。你那句话还没说完。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I quite like the idea of leaving a cliffhanger there.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我倒是挺喜欢就在这儿留个悬念的。

lines.en: : In fact...I think I’ll let you sweat for a little while longer.
lines.zh: : 事实上……我想再让您多煎熬一会儿。

lines.en: : How {i}much{/i} longer exactly? Because I don’t have all night.
lines.zh: : 具体还要{i}多久{/i}？因为我可没有一整晚的时间。

lines.en: : Of course you do. I advised you in the very beginning that this could run until tomorrow. And I need you here to make sure my plan pans out.
lines.zh: : 您当然有。我一开始就提醒过您，这可能会一直持续到明天。而且我需要您在这儿，确保我的计划能成。

lines.en: : It’ll be significantly harder achieving the result I want all by myself, you know.
lines.zh: : 全靠我一个人，要达到我想要的结果会难得多，您知道的。

lines.en: : And that result is still...getting Otoha and Rin to fuck?
lines.zh: : 而那个结果仍然是……让 Otoha 和 Rin 上床？

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai15
: If it doesn’t happen tonight, I’m not sure it ever will.
lines.zh: : 如果今晚不成，我不确定还会有机会。

lines.en: : So I {i}suppose{/i} you can walk away now if your end goal is sleeping with each of them quicker...
lines.zh: : 所以，如果您的最终目标是尽快把她们挨个睡一遍，那您现在就可以走了……

lines.en: : But, if you’d like to take your time and focus on the {i}others{/i} for now...and let the two of {i}them{/i} explore one another's bodies on their way to makeshift happiness...
lines.zh: : 但如果您愿意慢慢来，暂时把注意力放在{i}其他人{/i}身上……让{i}她们俩{/i}在通往临时幸福的路上，去探索彼此的身体……

lines.en: scene black
: Stay with me.
lines.zh: : 留在我身边。

lines.en: : Until the sun rises once more.
lines.zh: : 直到太阳再次升起。

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai16
She didn’t need to try and convince me.
lines.zh: 她本不必来说服我。

lines.en: As much as I’d enjoy having sex with all three of the girls I’m with tonight, I know it would be wrong to insert myself both in between and {i}inside{/i} of the two furthest away from me.
lines.zh: 虽然我很乐意和今晚同行的三个女孩都上床，但我知道，把自己插进离我最远的那两人中间、插进她们{i}体内{/i}，是错的。

lines.en: All things considered, it would be wrong to insert myself inside of Nodoka as well — but that is a different sort of unacceptable that I’ve made overwhelmingly apparent to be unimportant to me.
lines.zh: 综合来看，把自己插进 Nodoka 体内同样也是错的——但那属于另一种“不可接受”，而我已经极其明确地表示过，那种事对我来说无所谓。

lines.en: What I’m trying to say is I want Rin to be happy. And to a real, yet relatively lesser extent, Otoha as well.
lines.zh: 我想说的是，我希望 Rin 幸福。而在真实但相对次要的程度上，我也希望 Otoha 幸福。

lines.en: And if that means sidelining myself and going along with the plan of someone who may very well be a sociopath, so be it.
lines.zh: 如果这意味着我要把自己放到一边，去配合某个很可能是反社会人格的人的计划，那就这样吧。

lines.en: Because at least she’s being a sociopath in a nice way tonight and not locking the two of them in a room together and disallowing them to leave until they sixty-nine.
lines.zh: 因为至少今晚她当反社会人格的方式还算温和，没有把她俩锁进一个房间、不许她们出来，直到她们六九式为止。

lines.en: If that winds up happening, I’ll cut the cord with Nodoka for good.
lines.zh: 如果真变成那样，我就彻底跟 Nodoka 一刀两断。

lines.en: Involve me in borderline sexual assault one time, shame on you. Involve me in that same thing twice...and we should probably both be in jail.
lines.zh: 让我卷进一次近似性侵的事，是你的错。让我卷进第二次同样的事……那我们俩大概都该进监狱了。

lines.en: I still don’t know what her plan is- nor how I can help her with it.
lines.zh: 我依然不知道她的计划是什么——也不知道我能怎么帮她。

lines.en: But I know that, until the sun rises once more, I’ll be right here beside her.
lines.zh: 但我知道，在太阳再次升起之前，我都会守在她身边。

lines.en: : You guys ever just think about tacos? What an amazing invention these things are. They’re like little boats that you can eat.
lines.zh: : 你们有没有单纯地思考过塔可？这东西真是了不起的发明。它们就像一艘艘可以吃的小船。

lines.en: : Very nice, Rin. Is that really all you’re having, Nodoka? Just...a single croquette? Rin and I have stopped at like seven stalls so far and I’m starting to feel bad.
lines.zh: : 说得真好，Rin。Nodoka，你就吃这个？就……一个可乐饼？我和 Rin 已经吃了得有七个摊子了，我开始过意不去了。

lines.en: : I’m not very hungry. But don’t let my poor appetite spoil dinner for either one of you. Stop wherever you like. The night is just getting started after all.
lines.zh: : 我不太饿。但别让我糟糕的胃口坏了你们俩的晚餐。想在哪儿停就在哪儿停。毕竟夜晚才刚刚开始。

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai17
: {i}Started?{/i} Are we doing something after this? Because the answer to that question greatly influences the amount of tacos I am about to eat.
lines.zh: : {i}开始{/i}？我们之后还有活动？因为这个问题的答案，将极大地影响我接下来要吃多少塔可。

lines.en: : I just figured it would be nice to wander through the streets with a group of people I’m close to. If only my dear Futaba was here to join us as well.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，能和我亲近的一群人一起在街头闲逛，会很不错。要是我亲爱的 Futaba 也在，那就更圆满了。

lines.en: : You’re...the one who explicitly decided to not invite her. You can’t do that and then just wish she was here.
lines.zh: : 你……明明就是那个明确决定不邀请她的人。你不能一边这么做，一边又希望她在这儿。

lines.en: : I neglected to invite Futaba for her own well-being as discussing my latest work with her might prove to be a bit...difficult.
lines.zh: : 我没邀请 Futaba，是为了她好，因为跟她讨论我的新作可能会有点……困难。

lines.en: : Besides, I’m {i}fun{/i} Nodoka right now. I don’t want to {i}explain{/i} things. I explained things all day.
lines.zh: : 再说，我现在是“{i}玩乐模式{/i}的 Nodoka”。我不想{i}解释{/i}东西。我解释了一整天了。

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai18
: Right now, what I want more than anything is to enjoy my free time with you.
lines.zh: : 现在，我最想要的，就是和你们一起享受这段自由时光。

lines.en: : Because who knows when the next time I’ll see either of you is after you discover how nice it feels to scissor later tonight?
lines.zh: : 因为谁知道呢——等你们今晚发现彼此磨镜有多美妙之后，我下次再见到你们其中一个会是什么时候？

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai19
: Did I say something wrong? I meant that sincerely.
lines.zh: : 我说错什么了吗？我可是真心这么想的。

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai20
: Nodoka, it’s {i}because{/i} you meant it sincerely that it’s weird. Stop trying to rush us. Otoha wants to move slow.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，正{i}因为{/i}你是真心的，才更奇怪。别再催我们了。Otoha 想慢慢来。

lines.en: : Seriously. Like, why do you have to be so involved in our personal...{i}stuff{/i} anyway? It has nothing to do with you.
lines.zh: : 说真的。你到底为什么非要掺和我们私人的……{i}事{/i}啊？这跟你一点关系都没有。

lines.en: : My dearest Otoha, I’m writing a series based on our lives. {i}Everything{/i} has to do with me now. If you delay any longer, I’ll just wind up having to make something else up. And where’s the fun in that?
lines.zh: : 我最亲爱的 Otoha，我写的这个系列是基于我们生活的。现在{i}一切{/i}都跟我有关系。要是你们再拖下去，我就只能编点别的了。那还有什么乐趣？

lines.en: : The fun is {i}not{/i} getting in between us.
lines.zh: : 乐趣在于{i}别{/i}插到我们中间来。

lines.en: : I can’t say I agree. I think I’d have plenty fun in between you. But I understand that may be a little too much for {i}all{/i} of us right off the bat.
lines.zh: : 我可不同意。我觉得我要是插在你们中间，会很有乐趣。不过我也理解，一上来就那样，对我们{i}所有人{/i}来说可能有点过。

lines.en: : Otoha- permission to throw a taco at your roommate?
lines.zh: : Otoha——申请朝你室友扔一个塔可？

lines.en: : Permission granted.
lines.zh: : 批准。

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai21
: Wait, wait, wait. There’s no need to throw anything at me.
lines.zh: : 等等，等等，等等。没必要朝我扔东西。

lines.en: : All that will do is dirty this suit and force my boyfriend here to help me undress right in the middle of this shotengai. And I’m sure {i}no one{/i} wants to see that.
lines.zh: : 那只会弄脏这身西装，逼我的男朋友在这商店街正中间帮我脱衣服。而我相信{i}没人{/i}想看那个。

lines.en: : Taco attaaaaaaack!
lines.zh: : 塔可袭——击——！

lines.en: : Rin, wait. No taco attack.
lines.zh: : Rin，等等。别扔塔可。

lines.en: : No taco attaaaaack!
lines.zh: : 塔可袭——击——！

lines.en: : Nodoka, I’m gonna be real with you. It’d be super cool if you stopped trying to start problems just so you could get some exciting material for your book or whatever. We’re not...{i}playthings.{/i}
lines.zh: : Nodoka，我跟你说实话。如果你能别为了给你的书找什么带劲的素材，就拼命制造问题，那就再好不过了。我们不是……{i}玩具{/i}。

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai22
: Otoha, thank you for “being real” with me. But you’re wrong.
lines.zh: : Otoha，谢谢你的“实话”。但你错了。

lines.en: : I’m not trying to start problems at all.
lines.zh: : 我根本没想制造任何问题。

lines.en: : Have I done that in the past? Maybe. Will I do it in the future? Another maybe. But right now, I’m just being eaten alive by curiosity.
lines.zh: : 我过去做过吗？也许。将来会做吗？也是个也许。但现在，我只是被好奇心活活啃噬着。

lines.en: : Your youth only comes once. Shouldn’t the two of you be making the most of it by engaging in constant lesbian sex with one another? That’s what {i}I{/i} would be doing if {i}I{/i} had a girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 你们的青春只有一次。你们俩难道不该充分利用，不停地进行百合性爱吗？如果{i}我{/i}有女朋友，{i}我{/i}就会那么做。

lines.en: : But alas, my desired female partner is but one more who has fallen victim to our teacher’s phallus.
lines.zh: : 可惜啊，我想要的女性伴侣，也不过是又一个拜倒在我们老师那根阳具之下的受害者。

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai23

: Oh, and that’s another thing! Sensei, why are you not saying anything when Nodoka’s basically putting your whole ass creepy lifestyle on blast?! You saw yourself how many weird looks you were getting tonight!
lines.zh: : 哦，还有一件事！Sensei，Nodoka 基本上是在把你整个变态的生活方式往死里曝光，你为什么一句话都不说？！你今晚也看到了，有多少人用那种奇怪的眼神看你！

lines.en: : Otoha’s right. Couldn’t this book start like, major problems for you if the wrong person finds out about it?
lines.zh: : Otoha 说得对。万一被不该知道的人发现了，这本书难道不会给你惹上大麻烦吗？

lines.en: : The two of you are overreacting. Fiction is fiction at the end of the day. And even novels that are based on real life events are often exaggerated beyond recognition. This is no different from that.
lines.zh: : 你们俩反应过度了。说到底，虚构就是虚构。就算是取材自真实事件的小说，也常常夸张到认不出原形。这本也不例外。

lines.en: : I’ve even gone so far as to change the names of everyone involved.
lines.zh: : 我甚至把所有相关人物的名字都改了。

lines.en: : I don’t know. Rin to Ren doesn’t sound like that big of a change.
lines.zh: : 我可不知道。Rin 改成 Ren，听起来也没多大区别。

lines.en: : Neither does Otoha to Otoka...
lines.zh: : Otoha 改成 Otoka 也是……

lines.en: : If the two of you would just take the time to actually {i}read{/i} the book before critiquing it to this extent, you’d have much more room to talk.
lines.zh: : 如果你们俩能先花点时间真正{i}读一读{/i}这本书，再来批判到这种程度，你们会更有发言权。

lines.en: : But for now, I’d like to get back to the topic at hand and ask you when the two of you will be bringing each other to orgasm. Which, for the record, Sensei is also curious about.
lines.zh: : 不过现在，我想回到正题，问你们俩打算什么时候让彼此高潮。顺便声明一下，Sensei 对此也很好奇。

lines.en: : She’s not wrong. But also for the record, I have no part in this and haven’t really figured out how I feel about her book yet.
lines.zh: : 她没说错。不过也声明一下，这事儿没我的份，而且我还没想清楚我对她这本书是什么感觉。

lines.en: : Stop being curious about...stuff you shouldn’t be curious about! If you’re that horny, just fuck Nodoka or something! At the very least, it’ll get her off our backs!
lines.zh: : 别对……你不该好奇的东西好奇了！你要是这么饥渴，干脆去操 Nodoka 什么的！至少那样她就不会再来烦我们了！

lines.en: : Or...{i}don’t{/i} do that. Because you already have other people who...actually love you.
lines.zh: : 或者……{i}别{/i}那样。因为你已经有别的人……真的爱你。

lines.en: : Are you implying I don’t love my very own father-slash-boyfriend?
lines.zh: : 你是在暗示我不爱我亲爱的父亲兼男朋友吗？

lines.en: : Not in a way that sounds legal or socially acceptable...
lines.zh: : 至少不是以那种听起来合法、或者能被社会接受的方式……

lines.en: : Otoha, like I said, I’m not involved in this- nor am I going to try and force you two into doing anything you don’t want to.
lines.zh: : Otoha，我说过了，我没掺和这事——我也不会去逼你们俩做任何你们不想做的事。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you have no issue helping {i}Nodoka{/i} do that, which is no different. Man up, dude.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你帮 {i}Nodoka{/i} 那么做就没问题，那还不是一回事。有点担当好吗，老兄。

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai24
: You know I love you...don’t you, Papa? Or should I whisper it in your ear again tonight while we’re cuddled up in bed?
lines.zh: : 您知道我爱您的……对吧，爸爸？还是说，今晚我们挤在床上的时候，要我再在您耳边说一次？

lines.en: : Maybe...tone it down a little, Nodoka. I get that you have a difficult time noticing things like this, but Otoha’s actually starting to get kind of heated.
lines.zh: : 也许……稍微收敛一点，Nodoka。我知道你很难察觉这种事，但 Otoha 是真的开始有点上火了。

lines.en: : Yeah, because I’m sick of people trying to tell me who I’m supposed to be or what I’m supposed to do or how I’m supposed to feel.
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为我受够了别人来告诉我我该是谁、我该做什么、我该怎么感受。

lines.en: : Also, I’ve been holding onto this burger for so long without biting it that it’s probably bad now. So thanks, guys.
lines.zh: : 还有，这个汉堡我拿了这么久没咬一口，现在大概已经坏了。所以谢了，各位。

lines.en: : Yeah...and my tacos have gotten so soggy that I’m not sure they’re even throwable anymore. Can we go back so I can get more?
lines.zh: : 是啊……而且我的塔可已经软塌到我不确定还能不能扔出去了。我们能回去再买点吗？

lines.en: : Psst...Papa.
lines.zh: : 嘘……爸爸。

lines.en: : What do you want, fake-daughter?
lines.zh: : 你想要什么，假女儿？

lines.en: : Ask them when they plan on fingering one another and I’ll do things to you in the closet later.
lines.zh: : 问她们打算什么时候互相用手插进去，我就在柜子里对您做点什么。

lines.en: : Nodoka...
lines.zh: : Nodoka……

lines.en: : Come on...The only way we’ll get them is through repetition.
lines.zh: : 来嘛……我们唯一能拿下她们的办法就是反复施压。

lines.en: : Sensei’s name is Akira and he’s been hiding it from everyone for reasons I don’t understand.
lines.zh: : Sensei 的名字是 Akira，他一直瞒着所有人，理由我搞不懂。

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai25
: Hah...
: You have a name?!
lines.zh: : 你有名字？！

lines.en: : Akira?...
lines.zh: : Akira？……

lines.en: : You want to be on Nodoka’s side? Fine. I can throw dirt back at you. That was just the beginning.
lines.zh: : 你想站到 Nodoka 那边？行。我也能朝你泼脏水。这才只是个开始。

lines.en: : I was literally about to refuse Nodoka’s offer. But you were so trigger happy and determined to spill that information that you fired as soon as I opened my mouth.
lines.zh: : 我刚才正要拒绝 Nodoka 的提议。可你太急着扣扳机、太执意要把那件事抖出来，我一张嘴你就开火了。

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai26
: Oh.
: Whoops.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。

lines.en: : YOU HAVE A NAME?!
lines.zh: : 你有名字？！

lines.en: : I’m so used to you doing everything in the completely incorrect way that I kind of just figured that’s what you were going to do again. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 我看你做什么事都用完全错误的方式，我都习惯了，就以为你这次又要来一遍了。对不起。

lines.en: : In my defense, though, normal Sensei would never say no to having things done to him in the closet. So this is also kind of your fault for growing a spine out of literally nowhere.
lines.zh: : 不过说句公道话，正常的 Sensei 是绝不会拒绝在柜子里被人对他做些什么的。所以这也算是你的错，谁让你从石头缝里突然长出一根脊梁骨。

lines.en: : Also, your name is rad. What’s there to even be embarrassed about?
lines.zh: : 还有，你的名字很酷啊。有什么好难为情的？

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai27
: Akira...Arakawa...
lines.zh: : Akira……Arakawa……

lines.en: : YOU-
: Rin, shh. Eat this burger.
lines.zh: : Rin，嘘。把这个汉堡吃了。

lines.en: : Mmffffghfhfissssocold!
lines.zh: : 嗯呜呜呜——好冰！

lines.en: : May I ask why you were keeping that name a secret?
lines.zh: : 我能问一下您为什么一直瞒着这个名字吗？

lines.en: : I technically {i}wasn’t,{/i} but...it’s a long story.
lines.zh: : 严格来说也{i}不算{/i}瞒着，不过……说来话长。

lines.en: : Is it...one you’d be willing to share?
lines.zh: : 是那种……您愿意分享的故事吗？

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai28
: Any reason why you’re so interested all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 怎么突然这么感兴趣？

lines.en: : No...not particularly.
lines.zh: : 不……没什么特别的。

lines.en: : Just wondering...
lines.zh: : 只是好奇……

lines.en: : You’re significantly less wordy and pretentious all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 你突然变得话少又不装腔作势了。

lines.en: : What do you mean? I’m the same person as always.
lines.zh: : 什么意思？我还是那个我。

lines.en: scene nodokashotengai29
: Ithnkyrjust.........
lines.zh: : 我觉得你只……………

lines.en: : Imgningthngs...
lines.zh: : 在胡想……

lines.en: : Nodoka?
lines.zh: : Nodoka？
